dogecoin.text: People getting mad at @elonmusk for tanking their #cryptocurrency is hilarious. He helped #dogecoin go from something that was worth fractions of a penny into what it is today. It’s not his fault you made a bad investment and bought it at $.60 🤷🏻‍♂️
#dogecoin reminds me of owning a small business. When things are going well, everything is great. The moment things go wrong, doubt sets in and you start looking for a new business ideas.

All this talk about #btc #dogecoin #Ethereum is great entertainment. When it’s up everyone’s an expert & has answers. When it’s down everyone is looking for answers. Instead of looking for answers you should be buying. The key is to spread out your buying on the way down. DCA
